title: Iʿtiqādāt ('Statement of Creed')
transliterated_title: Iʿtiqādāt (var. Muʿtaqadāt; Muʿtaqadiyya; ʿAqīda; R. dar Iʿtiqād; Iẓhār-i Iʿtiqād)

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (Herat, ff. 165b-72a); a copying date and only a terminus ad quem; not asterisked. Place of composition only 'presumably' Herat.

place: Herat (presumed; the Majlis 10196 copy was made in Herat)
addressee: Shāhrukh (MK, citing Āqā Buzurg); companion to Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I
occasion: Written, per MK, during Ibn Turka's 'second trip to Herat' to clear his name of accusations of deviating from the Sunna and pro-Sufi bias.
manuscript: 8 items listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 165b-72a (Herat, 19 Jumādā I 829/29 March 1426); then MS 5423 (842/1439), MS 1825 (851/1447), BL Add. 23983 (858/1454), MS 10004 (903-4/1497-98), and later copies.
summary: A lengthy creed presenting Ibn Turka as a staunch Sunni-Ashʿarī and opponent of Muʿtazilism, philosophy, Shiʿism and messianic Sufism, on the theme of Q 11:54.
